subject: Polaris multi-page dossier renderer (#269, gap #8): renderDossier, writeDossierRun and poc:dossier-render, after the #269 review fixes
subjectSha256Method: sha256 of subjectFiles serialized as compact JSON with sorted keys, in the listed order
method: Each mutant replaced exactly one fragment (asserted to occur once) in the named file, ran the renderer test file (npx vitest run dossier-render.test.ts), and restored the file; the worktree was clean after each sweep. A mutant is killed when at least one test fails or the suite errors. Two sweeps make up this record. The full sweep of all 50 mutants ran at fullSweepCommit. Between that commit and the record commit, only dossier-render.test.ts changed: one strengthened case and three added cases, with no case removed or weakened, and every source subject is byte-identical. The subset sweep re-ran at the record commit the mutants that survived the full sweep, plus every mutant a changed case had killed. Each mutant's ranAt says which sweep its row comes from. dossier-evaluation.ts and draft-preview.ts are unmutated inputs.
history: At c8729542 the first record held 16 mutants, all killed; its subject files are superseded.

At 12d7f388 (pre-rebase), a sweep after the review fixes had two genuine survivors among the writer mutants, git-fail-open and realpath-skipped. A third, exists-check-noop, was a false survival, because the sweep was interrupted by a worktree restore mid-run; run alone, it was killed. d783dc5b added a test for a parent inside .git and made writeDossierRun return the real path it checked.

The full sweep at f82dfe63 killed 46 of 50. The survivors were escape-edge-target-label (only an edge's source node carried the payload), escape-open-item-question-1 and escape-open-item-reason-1 (no test), and escape-Mermaid-diagramToMermaid-1 (Mermaid's own encoding neutralises markup, so only the byte-level escape of its quotes and arrows shows the site). 2717d10a fixes the tests.
previewUnchanged: renderDraftPreview output was compared byte for byte, before and after extracting its CSP, stylesheet, escape and marking labels for reuse, on both synthetic projects (garden, archive): identical, sha256 9309b8c7075e86fc103e0e2371975a90dfdf291d9213c4aa0c1c25b288909042 and 04994409f9de72e3e994f96bf796c7d2e78e17e9e3757f02e216d79150fecbf3 on both sides. The comparison used a temporary copy of the pre-change file and was not committed.
